reviews.text: I've been going to Anna's for many years. My friend Leo, a setter, always bathed there for 10 years. Unfortunately, in 2020, he left me at the age of 17. I no longer wanted dogs; it hurts too much. With the idea of ​​putting him up for adoption, two months ago I rescued a 5-year-old Central Asian Shepherd from an abused dog. Unfortunately, no one wanted him, but I grew fond of him, so he'll live with me. That's why I went back to Anna's. I found the same professionalism, kindness, and helpfulness as when I went with Leo. Highly recommended.

Great experience
All the staff were kind and friendly.

Very negative experience! I don't recommend it at all! As soon as he finished grooming, my dog ​​started licking himself. Mrs. Anna dabbed it with talcum powder. Unfortunately, he had cuts from the shearing. He had to wear an Elizabethan collar for so long to avoid infection, and I had to buy soothing creams. Never again!!! First and last!!
They managed to ruin my poodle.....never again!!!

I have been taking my dogs to Anna Pokhodun for years. She is patient, professional, and uses excellent products. The grooming area is open to the public, so owners can watch their pets from the waiting room.
Great and serious professionals, fast and punctual in their work. Excellent price/quality ratio.
A neighborhood favorite for our four-legged friends. Always super satisfied!
Bad experience! I took my dog ​​to get her nails trimmed. She was crying, and instead of calming her down, she put on headphones!

Totally negative experience, except for the €5 price to trim the nails of a very calm Chihuahua... but I only went with my cell phone to pay with my debit card, and they slapped me with a €2 surcharge...!!!! Shameful!!!! Bring cash to this place... I won't be back!
